annotations.title: Translate a vague design request into design terms

description: Turns a vague design request ("make it pop", "it looks cheap", "too busy", "less AI-looking") into what designers usually mean by it and the specific design terms and values to use instead. Returns a ready-to-paste design brief and a link that opens it in Lingo.

avoid_ai_look.description: Add rules that steer away from the generic AI-made look. Default true.

phrase.description: The vague request in plain words, e.g. "it feels cheap and too busy".
